//allowedOrigins: Extra origins allowed to open a WebSocket. Same-origin is always allowed; add entries only if the UI is served from a different hostname than the API.
//trustedProxies: Only these peers are believed when they send X-Forwarded-For / X-Forwarded-Proto.
//terminal: A root shell over the network. Set enabled to false to turn it off without redeploying.
//fileRoots: The file manager cannot read or write outside these paths. Symlinks are resolved before the check. Each root appears as a button above the file list.
//fileRoots-whole-disk: To browse the entire filesystem the way CasaOS does, add { "name": "System", "path": "/" }. That is a real widening: the file manager could then delete anything on the box. It is also roughly what the built-in terminal already allows, so if you keep the terminal enabled it changes little in practice — but if you ever set terminal.enabled to false, this is the setting that still hands out the whole disk.
//smart: devices: [] means auto-detect from /sys/block. Polling uses --nocheck=standby so idle drives are never spun up.
